title: Prefixes & Suffixes: Word Formation, Meaning, Spelling and Exam Practice
description: Base words, roots, prefixes, suffixes, derived word formation, spelling changes, word families, parts of speech selection, aur Rajasthan High Court exam error elimination strategies ko systematically master karein.
learningObjectives: Base words, classical roots, prefixes, aur suffixes ke beech precise difference ko identify karein
Samajhein ki prefixes word meaning modify karte hain jabki suffixes aksar grammatical part of speech change karte hain
Negative aur opposite prefixes (un-, in-, im-, il-, ir-, dis-, non-, de-, anti-) ke phonetic assimilation rules ko master karein
Repetition, time, position, aur relationship prefixes (re-, pre-, post-, sub-, super-, inter-, intra-, trans-, co-, counter-) ko correctly apply karein
Number, quantity, aur scale prefixes (uni-, mono-, bi-, tri-, multi-, poly-, micro-, macro-, mega-) ke meaning ko decode karein
Noun-forming (-er, -or, -ist, -ian, -ness, -ity, -ment, -tion, -ance, -ship, -hood, -dom) suffixes se correct nouns derive karein
Adjective-forming (-ful, -less, -ous, -al, -ic, -able, -ible, -ive, -y, -ish, -ary, -ent) suffixes ko sentence context mein use karein
Verb-forming (-ize/-ise, -ify, -en, -ate) aur adverb-forming (-ly) suffixes ke patterns aur exceptions ko samjhein
Suffix add karte waqt hone wale spelling changes (final silent e, consonant + y, 1-1-1 consonant doubling) ko accurately implement karein
Complete word families (Noun, Verb, Adjective, Adverb) ko analyze karein aur wrong grammatical roles ko eliminate karein
Sentence completion questions mein syntax clues (article, auxiliary, preposition) se required word class identify karke sahi word select karein
9-Step Systematic Word Formation Workflow apply karke High Court aur state competitive exams ke MCQs mein 100% accuracy achieve karein

included: Core Morphology: Base words, roots, prefixes, suffixes, derived forms, and word families

Negative & Opposite Prefixes: un- (unhappy, unfair), in- (inaccurate, incomplete), im- before p/m (impossible, patient -> impatient, mature -> immature), il- before l (illegal, illogical, illiterate), ir- before r (irregular, irresponsible, irrelevant), dis- (disagree, disconnect, dishonest), non- (nonfiction, nonviolent), anti- (antiwar, antisocial), de- (deactivate, devalue, defrost)

Time, Position & Relationship Prefixes: re- (rewrite, reread), pre- (preview, prehistoric), post- (postgraduate, postwar), mid- (midnight, midterm), fore- (foresee, forecast), ex- (ex-member, ex-president), inter- (international, interconnect), intra- (intranet, intramural), trans- (transport, transfer), sub- (submarine, substandard), super- (superhuman, superstar), over- (overwork, overestimate), under- (underpay, underestimate), mis- (misunderstand, mistake), mal- (malfunction, malnutrition), co- (co-worker, cooperate), counter- (counterattack, counterproductive)

Number, Quantity & Scale Prefixes: uni-/mono- (unicycle, monolingual), bi-/di- (bilingual, bilateral), tri- (triangle, tricycle), multi-/poly- (multilingual, polygon), semi-/hemi- (semicircle, hemisphere), micro- (microscopic), macro- (macroeconomic), mini- (minibus), mega- (megastore)

Noun-Forming Suffixes: -er/-or (teacher, actor), -ist (artist, scientist), -ian (musician, historian), -ness (kindness, happiness), -ity/-ty (activity, safety), -ment (development, achievement), -tion/-sion (education, decision), -ance/-ence (performance, difference), -ship (friendship), -hood (childhood), -dom (freedom), -ism (humanism), -ure (failure, departure)

Adjective-Forming Suffixes: -ful (careful, helpful), -less (careless, helpless), -ous/-ious (dangerous, famous, ambitious), -al (national, cultural), -ic (economic, scientific), -able/-ible (comfortable, accessible), -ive (creative, effective), -y (rainy, healthy), -ish (childish, greenish), -ary (imaginary), -ent/-ant (dependent, resistant)
Verb-Forming Suffixes: -ize/-ise (modernize, criticize), -ify (simplify, purify), -en (widen, shorten, strengthen), -ate (activate, validate)
Adverb-Forming Suffixes: -ly (quickly, carefully, happily) and distinguishing adjectives ending in -ly (friendly, lovely, lively, lonely) plus flat adverbs (fast, hard, late, well)

Spelling Laws: Final silent e (drop before vowel suffix, keep before consonant suffix), consonant + y (change to i before suffix except -ing), consonant doubling (1-1-1 CVC rule and primary stress), irregular family shifts (decide -> decision, strong -> strength)
Word Family Mapping: Systematically tracing noun, verb, adjective, and adverb relationships in high-frequency English roots
Sentence Completion: Contextual deduction of required word class from clausal syntax and structural cues
Competitive Exam Distractor Elimination: Filtering nonstandard derivatives, wrong parts of speech, and erroneous spelling forms
excluded: Idiomatic expressions and figurative phrases without morphological derivation (covered in Lesson 19)
Single-word substitutions and general vocabulary definitions (covered in Lesson 17)
Direct synonym and antonym pairing without affix analysis (covered in Lesson 16)
Syntactic clause transformations without morphological word-formation (covered in Lessons 08 and 09)
